commands.name: vault_create
commands.description: Makes a new vault in a folder with Create local vault in Obsidian's vault picker, and Obsidian opens it.

args.name: name
args.meaning: The vault's name, which is also its folder's name.

args.name: folder
args.meaning: The folder to make it in, which must exist.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": there is no background mode.

example_requests: Make a new Obsidian vault called Research
Create a vault in my Documents folder
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events. Obsidian is asked to show its window to Accessibility.
commands.postcondition: The vault's folder exists with Obsidian's settings in it, and Obsidian knows it.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: another app came to the front; nothing more was done

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: the folder doesn't exist; nothing is made

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.when: something already has that name in the folder; nothing is made

errors.name: OutsideAllowedRoot
errors.when: OBSIDIAN_ALLOWED_ROOT is set and a path is outside it; nothing is done

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background": there is no background mode

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Obsidian 1.9.14 (whose installed update ran as 1.12.7) only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
Only touches what OBSIDIAN_ALLOWED_ROOT allows if it is set; if it isn't set, any folder you can reach is accepted.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
Obsidian adds its own Welcome note to a new vault.
Sync and signing in weren't used.

commands.name: vault_list
commands.description: Lists the vaults Obsidian knows, from its own registry file.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": there is no background mode.

example_requests: Which Obsidian vaults do I have?
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events. Obsidian is asked to show its window to Accessibility.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: never raised by this command; listed for a consistent error set

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background": there is no background mode

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Obsidian 1.9.14 (whose installed update ran as 1.12.7) only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It reads Obsidian's registry file, so it works with Obsidian closed.

commands.name: note_create
commands.description: Makes a note in a vault with Obsidian's own obsidian://new link; links such as [[Other note]] are kept as written.

args.name: vault
args.meaning: The vault's folder, an absolute path or one starting with ~.

args.name: title
args.meaning: The note's title, which is also its file name; one line without /.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": there is no background mode.

example_requests: Make a note called Ideas in my vault
Add a note that links to Project Plan
Write this down as a new Obsidian note
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events. Obsidian is asked to show its window to Accessibility.
commands.postcondition: The vault has title.md holding exactly the text.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: another app came to the front; nothing more was done

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: Obsidian doesn't know a vault at that folder; nothing is changed

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.when: a note with that title exists; nothing is changed

errors.name: OutsideAllowedRoot
errors.when: OBSIDIAN_ALLOWED_ROOT is set and a path is outside it; nothing is done

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background": there is no background mode

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Obsidian 1.9.14 (whose installed update ran as 1.12.7) only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
Only touches what OBSIDIAN_ALLOWED_ROOT allows if it is set; if it isn't set, any folder you can reach is accepted.
It opens the note in Obsidian.
Notes in subfolders weren't tested.

commands.name: note_open
commands.description: Opens a note in its vault's Obsidian window with Obsidian's own obsidian://open link.

args.name: vault
args.meaning: The vault's folder, an absolute path or one starting with ~.

args.name: note
args.meaning: The note's path inside the vault without .md, such as Ideas or Projects/Plan.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": there is no background mode.

example_requests: Open my Ideas note in Obsidian
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events. Obsidian is asked to show its window to Accessibility.
commands.postcondition: The vault's window shows the note; no note file changes.

errors.name: NotFound

commands.name: plugin_install
commands.description: Installs a community plugin from Obsidian's directory into a vault and turns it on (the plugin's page through obsidian://show-plugin, Install, Enable); a vault in Restricted mode is taken out of it first.

args.name: vault
args.meaning: The vault's folder, absolute or starting with ~.

args.name: plugin_id
args.meaning: The plugin's id in Obsidian's community directory, such as obsidian-excalidraw-plugin.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": there is no background mode.

example_requests: Install the Excalidraw plugin in my vault
Turn on the Dataview plugin in ResearchVault
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events. Obsidian is asked to show its window to Accessibility.
commands.postcondition: The plugin is installed and listed as on in the vault's community-plugins.json.
